purpose: Teach: あきらめる/リーズナブル/数時間/いえよ/一遍/しきりに/たいして/そのうえ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、難しい事もすぐにあきらめるのは駄目よ
lines.en: Sho, giving up at the first sign of difficulty isn't going to work.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Clear enunciation on the key phrase. Patient—the tone of someone who's said this before and means it to stick. Slight lift at the end, inviting him to understand why.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんがリーズナブルなお店を教えて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa told me about a reasonable restaurant.
lines.style: Quick, bright delivery. Small eagerness in his voice—proud to have learned something and share it. No pretense. The genuine enthusiasm of a child who's made a discovery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはお仕事から数時間遅れて帰っていらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father will be a few hours late coming home from work.
lines.style: Gentle factual tone. No drama—she's simply informing him of what is. Warm underneath, but practical. A slight pause before delivering the time detail, giving him space to absorb.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに「ありがとう」っていえよって言われたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa told me I should say thank you to him.
lines.style: Soft, earnest delivery. He's reporting what he learned, not asking permission—but there's a quiet seeking of approval underneath. Slow pace. The sincerity of a child taking a lesson seriously.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんに一遍お電話してみてね
lines.en: Sho, why don't you give your grandmother a call sometime soon?
lines.style: Warm, light suggestion—not an order. The tone of someone planting a small idea. Gentle on the name. A slight lean forward in the voice, inviting him to think about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがしきりにテレビを見てらっしゃるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's been watching TV quite a lot lately.
lines.style: Quiet observation. No judgment—just noticing and reporting what he sees. Thoughtful pause before the observation, like he's been thinking about it. The voice of a child noticing something that matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、今日はたいして寒くないわね
lines.en: Sho, it's not very cold today, is it?
lines.style: Light, conversational—almost thinking aloud. A small shared observation between them. Warm but not forced. The tone that invites agreement, not a lesson.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、宿題終わったよ。そのうえ、お絵描きもしたよ
lines.en: Mom, I finished my homework. And I even drew a picture too.
lines.style: Bright, proud energy right from the start. Quick pace on the accomplishment. A natural lift at 'and I even'—he's eager to add the second achievement. Genuine delight, not performing.
